verdict.rationale: Vestd's own help docs describe Data rooms that let you store and share important files in one secure, central place. You choose what to include, explicitly including cap tables, agreements, financials and shareholder documents, and you control who gets access. That covers the core of a permissioned data room mixing cap table and underlying documents. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of external sharing with counsel and investors, granular permission levels (view-only, download controls, expiry), diligence features such as access logs or audit trails, whether cap tables appear as live views or only as uploaded files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors

citations.quote: our Data rooms let you store and share important files in one secure, central place
